CustomField.description: Whether this automation enforces a rule rather than providing a convenience. An automation marked this way cannot be switched off from the console or suppressed by a pause: the trigger dispatcher ignores the bypass, the pause and the enabled switch for it (ADR-0024).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this when the automation enforces a rule rather than providing a convenience. It then cannot be switched off from the console or suppressed by a pause.
CustomField.label: Always Runs
